concerns.text: T008-prep attempts to fetch 'data/cached_axpo_results.json' from a 'verified remote source' and fails loudly if unavailable. This contradicts the plan (Phase 0) and spec (FR-008) which mandate that outcomes be generated locally via the AXPO agent or a deterministic Oracle simulation (T008-sim-wrapper/T008-exec-axpo). T008-prep introduces an unauthorized external dependency that breaks the self-contained reproducibility flow required before T008-impl-cache can run.

T004-ext defines 'TimeoutExceededError' and 'MemoryLimitExceededError' in 'src/lib/resource_tracker.py', but the plan (Phase 1) and T004-integration explicitly state these exceptions must be defined in 'src/lib/errors.py'. This creates a circular/missing dependency: T004-integration imports from 'resource_tracker' (per task text) but the plan expects 'errors.py'. The artifact producer (T004-ext) and consumer (T004-integration/T016) are misaligned on the artifact location, causing an immediate ImportError at runtime.

T024-verify depends on reading 'state/intermediate/filtered_dataset.json' to check N ≥ 30. However, no preceding task (T005-ext, T017, or T008-impl-cache) explicitly produces this file. T005-ext and T017 only mention logging errors or tracking counts in memory. This creates a 'ghost dependency' where T024-verify will fail because the required artifact does not exist, violating the producer-before-consumer rule.

T015 (US1) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly states 'Dependency: Must run AFTER T014 completes'. A task cannot be parallel-safe if it has a hard sequential dependency on another task in the same phase. The [P] tag is incorrect and misleading for execution planning.

T008-impl-cache is correctly marked NOT [P] and depends on T008-exec-axpo/T008-sim-wrapper. However, T008-prep (which is marked [P]) is listed as a potential producer for T008-impl-cache. Since T008-prep is an invalid/contradictory task (see first concern), the dependency chain for T008-impl-cache is broken. T008-impl-cache must strictly depend on T008-sim-wrapper or T008-exec-axpo only.
